description: Background threads (4 by default, `UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE`) that run file system, DNS, async crypto and zlib work for you.
A separate V8 isolate with its own event loop and heap inside the same process. Communicates through `postMessage`.
A fixed set of long-lived workers that receive tasks from a queue (Piscina). Avoids the startup cost of one worker per task.
An `ArrayBuffer` moved to another thread without copying through the transfer list of `postMessage`.
`node:cluster` forks N processes that share a listening port. Each has its own memory, so state must live outside.
Running more instances (processes, containers, machines) behind a load balancer instead of a bigger single process.
